Third, idempotent pass for explicit Based on EP2 - StepID 660/670 use ep1EfficacyCheck/ep1AnalysisSpacingInfo which are both N/A on iterations where EVERY boundary checkbox is N/A and only ep2AnalysisSpacingInfo carries real values (e.g. a Both-endpoints Winning Condition with no per-side checkboxes at all). Same fix proven on feature_Dual_LogrankDOP TC_38 ITER_07 and feature_Dual_LogrankLogrank TC_37 ITER_07 (AI_IMPORT_AGENT.md 9.2 / IMPORT_LESSONS.md rule 18/19). Safe to always run: reconcilePeriodTable no-ops once its own target is met.

Covers the BLANK/N/A syncInterims default (defaults live to EP1-primary) - StepID 678 only fires when syncInterims is the EXPLICIT string "Based on EP1", which ITER_01 (syncInterims="N/A" literal) and ITER_06 (syncInterims blank) never match, so the boundary table never grew past its default 1 row for ITER_01 (needs 3). Mirrors the proven TC_37/TC_38 pattern of gating the default-mode reconcile on `SkipIf …==Based on EP2` (skip ONLY when explicitly the other mode) rather than `!=Based on EP1` (which misses every blank/N/A case). Idempotent alongside 678 - harmless no-op wherever 678 already reached the target.
